correctness.rationale: The covariogram is exactly the normalized difference density; a width-one body has difference body the unit disk. Across \(2n\) oriented sectors, the local tangent-cone simplex has coefficient \(\sin\alpha/(2\sin\phi\sin(\alpha-\phi))\). Uniform trimming at \(\delta=\sqrt{s}\log(1/s)\) controls quadratic curvature and other disk constraints. Endpoint bound C min(\(s^{3/2}\),\(s^2/\Delta\)) gives o(\(s^2\log(1/s)\)) total endpoint contribution. The exact angular integral yields n \(s^2\log(1/s)\), and radial integration yields \(n/(3A_n^2)\). The 278 finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The near-diameter probability is a natural rare-event observable for a recent canonical family of symmetry-constrained constant-width area minimizers. The sharp exponent \(\varepsilon^3\log(1/\varepsilon)\) differs from the disk \(\varepsilon^{5/2}\), exposing the interaction of corner and circular curvature. The complete all-odd-n coefficient \(n/(3A_n^2)\) yields a normalized inverse corner-count signature, far beyond a routine numeric recomputation.
